stem: Which sentence from the story best expresses its theme?

options.label: F
options.text: "We have to take care of our regulars because they're part of what makes Sam's Deli a special place."

options.label: G
options.text: Personally, I didn't think it would hurt for some of our regulars to try a new restaurant every now and then—or at least consider ordering a different type of sandwich.

options.label: H
options.text: "Your dad and I appreciate your help."

options.label: J
options.text: I took orders and made sandwiches while they kept the restaurant clean and visited with customers.
